slot.brief: Solve a simple trigonometric equation of the form sin θ = given value and write the general solution.

stem: The general solution of $\sin\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$, where $n\in\mathbb{Z}$, is

verdicts.working: Sine equals \(\sqrt{2}/2\) at \(\pi/4\) and \(3\pi/4\) in each \(2\pi\) period, giving option A.

working:
$\sin\theta=\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ gives $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ or $\theta=\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$ in $[0,2\pi)$. 
Hence $\theta=2n\pi+\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ or $\theta=2n\pi+\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$, $n\in\mathbb{Z}$.

Independent check: Sine equals \(\sqrt{2}/2\) at \(\pi/4\) and \(3\pi/4\) in each \(2\pi\) period, giving option A.
